That arm prints hitmsg(), then evaluates !rn2(3) && !Drain_resistance && !mhitm_mgc_atk_negated(magr, mdef, TRUE) in C short-circuit order; on success it calls losexp("life drainage"). At level 1 that call prints the fatal “Goodbye level 1.” message. The recorded step 29 has rn2(3)=0 and rn2(10)=8 inside mhitm_mgc_atk_negated(), and the C screen contains that message.
